nota: aiohttp.ClientSession: session.get(url) dentro de async with.
codigo:
from flask import Flask, request
import requests, httpx, aiohttp, urllib3
app = Flask(__name__)
@app.route('/p')
async def p():
    u = request.args.get('url')
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:
        async with s.get(u) as r:
            return await r.text()
